The unchanged pinned baseline passes all four validation commands with 707 tests.

unresolved: WP-200 has no public fenced, fsynced, bounded-retry audit write permitted while the matching intent remains active.
WP-200 has no public primitive to create the intentionally absent 99_meta/audit directory under the held context lock.
WP-200 byte-postimage staging cannot express the existing move and delete_generated operation vocabulary.
WP-220 cannot validate an in-memory or staged multi-document proposal overlay through its public API.
WP-210 has no durable mark-stale API after a post-commit rebuild failure.
The forbidden Wave 1 positive transaction/audit fixtures encode the loose schemas and cannot pass the required ADR 0010 tightening without a lead-owned baseline update or explicit path grant.
recommended_next_action: Implementation lead: add a bounded WP-200 public audit-write capability valid between apply and finalization, including first-use audit-directory creation and original/successor recovery semantics; decide move/delete support and any WP-220/WP-210 additions; update or grant ownership of the frozen Wave 1 transaction/audit fixtures; then rebase or recreate WP-300 and return it for implementation.
